evidence_boundary.next_access_action: Seek a freely accessible first-party exact item image and original source-bound solar field; no registration, payment, credentials or guessed identifiers.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Library catalog juxtaposition of 捷法立成 and G893 授時曆立成 does not prove the same book or direct copying.
A 1966 film production inventory is not a new independent medieval numeric witness.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Is the item reported under 66-1-1-A the same surviving physical copy as modern AKS descriptions?
Does an earlier independent original copy attest G893 six-place solar field and precision with matched epoch?
